why_this_file_exists: resource_gate_round1.json is already pinned as evidence on the W07-02 row (its digest is registered at rev 142), so it cannot be edited. One of its conclusions is wrong in a way the next window would trust, and the rule on this line is that a correction is added, never substituted.
what_was_wrong: resource_gate_round1.json measurement_1_no_authorized_x_backend concluded, from X_API_TOKEN, X_BEARER_TOKEN, TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN and RESEARCHOS_X_CREDENTIAL_REF all being absent, that the card's authorized_X_backend requirement is unmet in this environment. That reasoning assumed X is reached with an API token. It is not.
what_is_actually_true: adapters/sources/x.go drives a BrowserActRunner through BrowserActCLI{Executable}, parsing only public article fields via injected JavaScript, with the comment that Fetch reads X's authorized public search page and then the canonical post page and never inspects account sidebars or XHR authentication headers.

internal/domain/sources.go:304 wires it concretely: adapter = sources.XBrowser{Runner: sources.BrowserActCLI{Executable: browserActPath}, BrowserID: browserID}. So the requirement is an executable path plus a browser id, not a bearer token.
command -v browser-act resolves to /c/Users/yqyyds/.local/bin/browser-act, so the executable the product expects IS present. My absence-of-tokens sweep did not look for it.

Presence of the executable is not an authorized backend. What is still unmeasured is whether browser-act has a reachable authorized browser session to give a browser id, and whether x.com public search answers here. The W07-01 reviewer's X/BrowserAct unexercisable note describes their run, not this machine's capability, and I should not have inherited it as an environment verdict.
consequence: W07-02 may be executable for real rather than blocked, which changes the card's plan: the X leg should be attempted through the product path before any 明确阻塞 is recorded, and the deliverable's PARTIAL-not-COMPLETE injection is only meaningful once X has genuinely been tried or genuinely refused. Recording 明确阻塞 without trying it would be the same class of false statement as writing empty results as complete coverage, which is this card's named negative case.
next_measurement: Invoke browser-act through its skill (this project instructs that browser-act is never run directly from a shell) to establish whether an authorized browser and a usable browser id exist, then drive XBrowser.Fetch through the domain path with a bounded query and record the actual page, window, cursor and health. Only then decide whether the X row is a real success or a measured blockage.
unchanged_by_this_correction: The second measurement in resource_gate_round1.json stands and is confirmed by a later run: ops/ci/sources.py whitelists only W07-G01, W07-G02 and an empty check id, so a card check-id such as W07-02 is refused as unbound W07 selection regardless of mode, and W07-02 must answer its own selector. The R3 forwarding defect has since been fixed and measured (see r3_forwarding_fix_round1.json).
